nodes.title: I2 task list (durations, hours, dependencies, not-before dates)
nodes.where: the t(...) rows of redesign/team/I2/make_schedule.py; hours are EST with the source named per row (BUILD-GUIDE.md stage times, H1 and H2 plans)
nodes.note: planning data, not a measurement: every hour figure is EST until the build logs replace it

nodes.title: Limits read from the requirement text
nodes.text: R-BUILD-HOURS: <= 3 weeks (21 d) from first cut to first hover. R-SCHEDULE: first transition by build week 7; crash-repair loop >= 1.5 weeks calendar (10.5 d); twin flown before the 15 Dec order
nodes.basis: team/A2/REQUIREMENTS.md rows R-BUILD-HOURS and R-SCHEDULE (read 2026-11-13); these four limits have no key in params.json, so they are carried here as [21, 7, 10.5, 1]

nodes.title: CDR decision B2 (PROPOSED, not applied)
nodes.text: re-word R-BUILD-HOURS to '<= 90 team-hours of build (stages 2-10) to first hover and <= 5 weeks from first cut'
nodes.basis: review/CDR-2026-11-13/CDR-SUMMARY.md section 4, B2: needs the students' sign-off; A2 edits the requirement after it. Until then the limits above stand

nodes.title: Schedule figures from the task list (forward and backward pass)
nodes.equation: earliest start = max(not-before, finish of every dependency) ; slack = latest finish - earliest finish against complete_by ; build week = (date - build_start) // 7 + 1 ; build hours = sum of the build-phase task hours without the transport box (TB1)

nodes.title: Team-hours of build to first hover (BUILD-GUIDE stage times)
nodes.how: Log hours per task during the build; compare the total at first hover.
nodes.note: EST: the sum of the build-phase task hours, bench checks (stage 11) and the range check included, transport box excluded (SCHEDULE.md verdict table, CR-I2-02). G4's count is 111 h (CDR decision B2)

nodes.title: Calendar days from first cut to first tethered hover
nodes.how: Dates of the first cut and the first tethered hover in the build log.
nodes.note: limit: '<= 3 weeks from first cut' in R-BUILD-HOURS. Set by the serial 24 h cures of the build chain (CDR decision B2); no lever in the task list removes them

nodes.title: Build week of the first tethered hover
nodes.how: Date of the first tethered hover (gate 3) against the build start.
nodes.note: build week 1 starts on schedule.build_start; CR-I2-01 asks A1 whether the requirement is week 4 or 5

nodes.title: Build week of the first transition (gate 6)
nodes.how: Date of the first transition flight against the build start.

nodes.title: Crash-repair loop held in the plan
nodes.how: Task CR1 in the task list; >= 1.5 weeks calendar.

nodes.title: Slack of the last task against complete_by
nodes.how: Re-run after every change to the task list; the last task must end on or before schedule.complete_by.
nodes.note: with one crash-repair loop in the plan; CDR-BT-10 calls 2 d thin

nodes.title: Days between the last twin flight day and the December order
nodes.how: Date of the last twin flight (task TW3) against schedule.order_date.
